svg.title: Diagnostic suppression and severity policy
svg.desc: The tidy-specific part of ParsedAST's level adjuster moves to sawDiagnostic(). It edits the assembled diagnostic's severity. Retains clangd suppression, NOLINT, system-macro filtering and warnings-as-errors. Not byte-for-byte equivalent: the old guard required nonempty CTChecks; the new guard requires Context, so compiler-only tidy configuration works too.

svg.text: Retains clangd suppression, NOLINT, system-macro filtering and warnings-as-errors.
Not byte-for-byte equivalent: the old guard required nonempty CTChecks; the new guard requires Context, so compiler-only tidy configuration works too.
